Mali.title: Mali: Alger dénonce l'«alliance» des indépendantistes du FLA avec les «terroristes» du Jnim
Mali.summary: Le ministre algérien des Affaires étrangères a tenu des propos très virulents contre le Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA), lors d'une conférence de presse jeudi 26 novembre à Alger. Ahmed Attaf a dénoncé l'alliance des rebelles indépendantistes du nord du Mali avec les « groupes terroristes », à savoir les jihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (Jnim, lié à al-Qaïda).

Mali.title: Bamako face à l’ Ingérence de l’Ukraine aux côtés des groupes armés du Sahel
Mali.summary: La question du soutien de Kiev aux groupes armés actifs dans la bande sahélo-saharienne suscite une vive préoccupation au sein de l’opinion publique et des chancelleries de la région. Alors que les pays de l’Alliance des États du Sahel (AES) font face à des défis sécuritaires majeurs, plusieurs éléments récents tendent à documenter l’implication d’acteurs ukrainiens sur le terrain malien, poussant les autorités de Bamako à réclamer des mesures fermes pour préserver leur souveraineté.

Mali.title: Mali: The FAMa are intensifying their offensives...
Mali.summary: Mali: The FAMa are intensifying their offensives in Kayes and around Dandougou. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing their offensive operations as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. .

Mali.title: Mali: Mali Remains Strategic for Russia Despite Heavy Losses, Investigator Says
Mali.summary: Russia is unlikely to pull out of Mali despite losing more than 10 percent of its forces there, an investigator who tracks Russian military deployments told RFI. Lou Osbourn co-founded All Eyes On Wagner, a collective of journalists and cybersecurity analysts. She said the losses prove that Russian fighters are taking part in operations alongside Malian troops and that "Africa remains an area of interest for Moscow".

Mali.title: MALI: An ka Tonka duguden dɔ lamɛn JNIM ka kankarimada kan, u bɛ ka fɔ ko dugudenw ka dugu in bila
Mali.summary: Mali la, nin y'a tile damadɔ ye ni kankarimada-dantigɛli dɔ bi ka yara bɔlɔlɔ foroba kumanyɔrɔw sanfɛ, o dantigɛli min kɔnɔ a fɔlen lon ko bi Novembre kalo tile 27 dilen bɛ Tonka-kaw ma u ka Dugu in bila. Tonka ye Mali Kɔrɔnyanfan dugu dɔ ye Tombouctou mara kɔnɔ, yen min yɛrɛ la bɔlɔlɔ sanfɛ kumanfɔla Sinfin Mariam Cissé fagara Salon Novembre kalo la, ani Dugu in mɔgɔ lakodoni wɛrɛw o kɔ.

Mali.title: Securing the territory: several terrorists neutralised and equipment seized during FAMa operations
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the nation that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. On Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the FAMa carried out ground and air offensive operations in several areas of the national territory.

Mali.title: Mali: The army announces strikes against terrorist groups in several regions
Mali.summary: The FAMa (Malian Armed Forces) have announced that they eliminated a large number of terrorists during operations carried out on Wednesday and Thursday across Mali. A statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, published on Friday, 27 November, reports this information. .

Mali.title: Bamako: Two young burglars arrested with 20 million CFA francs worth of jewellery
Mali.summary: Bamako: Two young burglars arrested with CFA 20 million worth of jewellery The Sabalibougou police station has arrested two young men, aged 21 and 22, suspected of burgling a house in Baco-Djicoroni Golf. The police recovered jewellery estimated to be worth 20 million CFA francs. The two suspects, identified by their initials L.T.

Mali.title: Mali : Alger dénonce l’alliance du FLA avec les jihadistes du Jnim
Mali.summary: L’Algérie hausse le ton face aux indépendantistes de l’Azawad, dénonçant leur rapprochement avec le Jnim. Le ministre Ahmed Attaf écarte toute reprise de la médiation et s’inquiète de la multiplication des ingérences étrangères. Publié aujourd'hui à 11h07, modifié à 12h17 Lecture : 3 minutes.

Mali.title: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to blockade Tonka
Mali.summary: Mali: Following the arrival of the army and Africa Corps, JNIM threatens to impose a blockade on Tonka In northern Mali, the jihadist group JNIM is threatening to impose a blockade on the trading town of Tonka. This show of force comes a month after the arrival of the Malian army and its Russian allies from Africa Corps. .

Mali.title: DÉFENSE ET SÉCURITÉ : Assimi Goïta réaffirme le cap de la montée en puissance des FAMa, l’héritage du Général Sadio Camara au cœur de la refondation militaire
Mali.summary: MALI : Sous le leadership d’Assimi Goïta, la modernisation de l’armée demeure une priorité nationale À Koulouba, le 24 novembre 2026, le Président de la Transition, Chef suprême des Armées, le Général d’armée Assimi Goïta, a réuni les principaux responsables du commandement militaire et des services de défense et de sécurité. Une rencontre stratégique qui traduit la volonté des plus hautes autorités de poursuivre la modernisation de l’outil de défense, de renforcer la coordination opérationnelle et de consolider les acquis enregistrés sur le terrain.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Diéma: Official Presentation of the National Flag to the Village Chief
Mali.summary: Diéma, 26 November (AMAP) In a solemn atmosphere filled with pride, the official ceremony for the handover of the national flag to the new village chief of Diéma, Cheicknè Sissoko, took place on Thursday in Diéma, in the presence of the 2nd Deputy Prefect, Attayoub Ould Mohamed, who was accompanied by the Sub-Prefect of Dioumara, Mamadou Tiéna Boré, the 1st Deputy Mayor of Diéma, Abdoulaye Touré, and representatives of the Armed Forces.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike several terrorist positions and neutralise at least a dozen fighters
Mali.summary: On 23 and 24 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out a series of air operations and targeted strikes in several regions of Mali. These actions, carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, resulted in the neutralisation of at least a dozen terrorists and the disabling of seven motorcycles used by armed terrorist groups.

Mali.title: Mali – Gestion des personnes refoulées de Guinée : le CECOGEC appelle à la vigilance et au recensement des ressortissants étrangers
Mali.summary: Bamada.net – Dans le cadre du dispositif de gestion des personnes refoulées de Guinée, les autorités maliennes renforcent les mesures d’identification, de recensement et d’accompagnement des personnes concernées. À travers un communiqué publié le 25 novembre 2026, le Centre de Coordination et de Gestion des Crises (CECOGEC) invite les populations à collaborer activement avec les forces de sécurité afin de faciliter le regroupement et la prise en charge des personnes encore dispersées sur le territoire national.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: 181 drones and other military equipment seized at Ouagadougou Airport
Burkina Faso.summary: Surveillance and reconnaissance drones, communications equipment, military uniforms and clothing. This is the batch of equipment intercepted by the Special Customs Brigade at Ouagadougou Airport this Wednesday. "The intercepted equipment includes various items of military hardware, Starlink satellite communication terminals and 181 drones, with an estimated value of over 80 million CFA francs," stated Burkina Faso Customs in a press release.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso seeks Nigeria’s partnership against terrorism, trafficking
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkinabe Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana and Nigeria’s Ambassador to Burkina Faso, Syndoph Endoni during talks on security cooperation between both countries By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA — Burkina Faso has pledged to strengthen security cooperation with Nigeria to tackle terrorism, drug trafficking, human trafficking and other cross-border crimes threatening stability in West Africa.

Burkina Faso.title: 21st Digital Week: Disinformation, a major threat to the AES confederation area
Burkina Faso.summary: 21st Digital Week: Disinformation, a major threat to the AES confederal area On the eve of the official closing of the 21st edition of Digital Week, on Thursday, 26 November, a panel was dedicated to cybersecurity in the confederal area of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES). . Under the theme ‘Cybersecurity and digital trust in the face of cross-border threats’, the discussions enabled the various panellists to explore possible solutions to better prevent cyber threats and organise the response in the event of an attack.

Burkina Faso.title: Avis de recrutement INTERNE & EXTERNE un-e Chef-fe de projet FHRAOC
Burkina Faso.summary: Norwegian Church Aid (NCA) dont le mandat est de sauver des vies et œuvrer pour la justice, est l’une des plus grandes organisations humanitaires des pays nordiques. Grâce à notre réseau international et à nos organisations partenaires au sein de l’Alliance ACT, nous sommes en mesure de fournir de l’aide d’urgence et de développement chaque année à des millions de personnes à travers le monde.

Niger.title: Sanam (Tillabéri): A terrorist attack on the National Guard leaves 13 dead and several attackers neutralised
Niger.summary: Niamey, 26 November (ANP) – The Niger National Guard (GNN) post in Sanam, in the department of Abala (Tillabéri), was the target on Thursday, 26 November 2020, of a terrorist attack carried out by numerous heavily armed assailants, according to a statement from the Ministry of National Defence published on Thursday evening. This attack resulted in heavy casualties among the ranks of the Defence and Security Forces (DSF).

Niger.title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
Niger.summary: Armed men on Thursday killed at least 13 Nigerien guards in an attack in the restive Tillaberi region in western Niger, the defence ministry said in a statement. The Nigerien National Guard was targeted "by a terrorist attack carried out by a large group of heavily armed assailants," the ministry said in a statement read on public television. Niger, ruled by a military junta since a 2023 coup, is battling violence by jihadists linked to Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State group, with thousands killed over the last decade.

Niger.title: SORAZ DONATES FOUR DT MOTORBIKES TO THE INTERREGIONAL JUDICIAL POLICE SERVICE IN ZINDER
Niger.summary: On Monday, 16 November 2020, the Zinder Refining Company (SORAZ) held a ceremony to donate four (4) motorbikes to the Interregional Criminal Investigation Department (SIRPJ) of the city of Zinder. This initiative is part of SORAZ's commitment to supporting the security forces in carrying out their duties to protect people and property, and represents a further practical example of cooperation between the company and local authorities.

Niger.title: Image Published on 27 November 2026 Niger, Africa: The Ministry of Defence announces the deaths of 13 guards in a terrorist attack At least 13 Nigerien guards were killed and twenty others injured on Thursday, 26 November, in a “terrorist attack” targeting their position in…
Niger.summary: At least 13 Nigerien guards were killed and twenty others injured on Thursday, 26 November, in a "terrorist attack" targeting their position in Sanam, in the west of the country, the Ministry of Defence announced in a statement. Nigerien police officers take part in a special US programme, 13 April 2018. Stock photo.

Niger.title: PANDEF seeks police, DSS probe into attack on Omo-Agege’s campaign team
Niger.summary: The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF) has called on the Department of State Services (DSS) and the police to investigate the killing of two aides of former Deputy Senate President, Ovie Omo-Agege, and two others during a political rally in Delta State. PANDEF also urged security agencies to identify and prosecute those who masterminded, sponsored or participated in the attack, which occurred on Monday at Uduere community in Ughelli North Local Government Area of the state.

Niger.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
Niger.summary: At least 13 members of Niger’s National Guard have been killed and 20 wounded in an attack on their compound in Sanam, in the west of the country, the Defence Ministry has said. In a statement read on state television, the ministry said the attack on Thursday was carried out by “numerous heavily armed assailants”, referring to the incident as a “terrorist attack”.

Niger.title: Niger: 13 soldiers killed in a new terrorist attack in Sanam (Tillabéri)
Niger.summary: On Thursday, 26 November 2020, the Niger National Guard (GNN) position in Sanam, in the department of Abala (Tillabéri region), was the target of a terrorist attack carried out by "numerous heavily armed attackers", the Ministry of National Defence announced in a statement issued in the evening. According to the same source, the provisional toll stands at 13 soldiers killed and 20 injured, including several serious cases who were evacuated for medical treatment.
